blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **сво́йство** — property, virtue, quality (attribute or abstract quality associated with an object). Wiktionary: свой + -ство.
**уби́йство** — murder, homicide (the action of killing someone). Wiktionary: уби́ть + -ство.
**родство́** — relationship, kinship, affinity (family relationship through marriage of a relative). Wiktionary: род + -ство.
**соверше́нство** — perfection, consummation, fineness, polish. Wiktionary: совершенный + -ство.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: murder, homicide (the action of killing someone)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: уби́йство — murder, homicide (the action of killing someone); бога́тство — wealth, riches; уча́стие — participation, collaboration, complicity; соверше́нство — perfection, consummation, fineness, polish.
